text: Remove the requests.json carry-over and the pre-0053 worktree folder search (data)?
context: 0078/F (PR #392) removes the one-time carry-over of an old .braid/requests.json onto the braid-requests branch, and the search for worktrees in the pre-0053 folder. The worker searched only this machine: no project here has a request in .braid/requests.json (openclaw holds an empty list), and no listed project has worktrees in the old folder. A project on another machine, or one not in braid projects, that never ran a braid command since the 0070 record would lose its open requests from that file (they stay in the file, but nothing reads them).

events.reason: No data is lost: old requests.json files and old-folder worktrees stay on disk and in git, and a revert brings the read paths back; nothing found on this machine. Cheap to reverse, so removed instead of kept indefinitely.

events.text: answer sent to the asking thread
